versions.changelog:
Initial release of tianapi-saylove-get skill.

- Provides a simple way to fetch a random "土味情话" (cheesy love line) from TianAPI.
- Requires an API Key from TianAPI, set via environment variable or command-line input.
- Includes clear setup and usage instructions for both script and direct API calls.
- Offers detailed guidance on error codes and troubleshooting.
- Intended for users seeking love lines, humorous confessions, or flirtatious quotes.
